Multiplied by 1.2: 1.2 S. Divided equally among 4: each gets (1.2 S)/4 = 0.3 S. Final payoff for player i: u_i = 20 - x_i + 0.3 S = 20 - x_i + 0.3 (x_i + sum_{j≠i} x_j) = 20 - x_i + 0.3 x_i + 0.3 sum_{j≠i} x_j = 20 - 0.7 x_i + 0.3 sum_{j≠i} x_j.

So each own contribution costs 0.7 but yields 0.3 to self via the share, net marginal effect of increasing own x_i by 1 is -0.7 + 0.3 = -0.4.
